expected_diagnosis: Webapp user lacks write permission on upload directory.
resolution_guidance: Correct narrowly scoped ownership/ACL with owner approval.
verification: Webapp writes test file; permissions remain least-privilege.
escalate_when: Shared mount ownership or policy unclear.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
